name: com.themostusefulsiteintheworld/tools
title: Most Useful Site — 1119 free browser tools
description: Search 1119 free browser tools (calculators, converters, generators, simulators), fetch full tool detail with embed snippets, list categories, and read key site pages as Markdown. Zero dependencies: runs anywhere with Python 3 over stdio.

transports.note: Run from a checkout of the repo, or point at server.py anywhere: it reads a local cards.json when present and fetches the live manifest otherwise.
